name: _OnHoverModifier
abstract: Observe pointer hover over this view's subtree. The handler fires with `true` on enter and `false` on leave; hovering a descendant (e.g. a button inside the container) keeps the container hovered, because hover is derived from the root→target hit path.

name: CursorModifier
abstract: Sets the OS mouse cursor that should appear while the pointer is hovering over the modified subtree. The `EventDispatcher` walks the hover path leaf → root and uses the deepest non-nil value; ancestors therefore act as fall-backs and `.cursor(.arrow)` can be used to "reset" within a subtree.
discussion:
Built-in primitives that imply a cursor (`Button` → `.pointer`,
`TextField` → `.ibeam`, `SplitView` divider → `.resizeHorizontal` /
`.resizeVertical`, `Slider` thumb → `.pointer`) wire their cursor through
this same `Node.cursor` slot, so user overrides win when nested closer to
the leaf.

name: Draggable
declaration: public struct Draggable<Payload: Hashable, Content: View, Preview: View>: View
abstract: A view that can start a drag with a typed payload and preview.
discussion:
A six-point movement starts the drag; a tap that never crosses the threshold
still reaches nested controls. Avoid placing a draggable directly inside a
vertical `ScrollView` unless the drag gesture is wanted to win over
scrolling; `ReorderableList` is the list-specific alternative.

name: DragScope
abstract: Shares a typed drag payload between descendants of one `DragScope`.
discussion:
The scope owns the session so payloads never escape into global state. A
drag preview is portal-rendered above clipping; dropping calls the target's
typed callback. Keyboard reordering is intentionally not implied: use
`ReorderableList` when the same collection needs an Up/Down path.

name: Scrollbar
abstract: Focusable scroll thumb for a caller-owned offset. It is a companion to `ScrollView`: bind the same offset and place it beside the viewport. The component paints only the track and thumb; the caller owns layout.
